# `oaap guard`

secret files: refused at the gateway, looked for in every instance (RFC-0084).

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap guard [--reason REASON]
                  {status,scan,allow,deny} [name] [category]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | what to do -- see Actions below |
| `name` | instance (scan, allow, deny) |
| `category` | allow/deny: env, vcs, keys, cloud, deploy, php, dumps |
| `--reason REASON` | allow: why the app serves such files |

## Actions

Whether an action needs `sudo` is read from the rule the node enforces, with the other arguments left out (e.g. `node care` reads, `node care measure` needs `sudo`).

| Action | Needs `sudo` |
|---|---|
| `status` | yes |
| `scan` | yes |
| `allow` | yes |
| `deny` | yes |
